name: cryo_column_ln2
description: Self-refilling LN2 reservoir: INSL-jacketed, TTAN-capped column with one cold CLNE(LN2) breeder.
why: Build-lessons 'infinite cryogen reservoir': LN2 dies by deletion at 77K and spawns at ambient unless created cold, so a single CLNE armed to LN2 and kept at -202C continuously reseeds the column; INSL stops the cold from bridging to the frame, TTAN caps the top against pressure.
source: save2, LN2 column x240-244 y272-291, CLNE(LN2) at (242,275), INSL liner, TTAN cap
